parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan assembly consisting of blades and the central hub, typically made of aluminum for lightweight and durability.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air, providing cooling and ventilation in a room.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting assembly of the ceiling fan, made of steel for structural support and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan motor and blades, connecting them securely to the ceiling.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary, providing a fixed support for the rotating fan assembly.
